login.heading: Your private wellness companion
login.reassurance: This space is yours. What you write here stays on your phone.
login.failed: That ID and password did not match. Please try again.

home.greeting: How are you doing this week?
home.supportive: Your check-in helps your welfare team support you.
home.checkedIn: Thanks for checking in this week.
home.openTransparency: What this app does with your information

checkIn.title: Wellness check
checkIn.intro: A few questions about your week. There are no right answers, and nobody sees your individual replies except your welfare team.
checkIn.thanksBody: That is all for this week. Your welfare team uses this to know where support is needed.
checkIn.queued: Saved on your phone. It will be sent when you are back on a network.

journal.title: Write something
journal.prompt: Anything you want to put into words. Nobody reads this but you.
journal.onDevice: Your words stay on this phone. Only a single number leaves it.
journal.keepOnPhone: Keep these words on my phone
journal.keepHint: Off by default. Nothing you write is ever sent, either way.
journal.unavailable: This phone cannot do the on-device reading. You can still write, and your words still stay here.
journal.voiceOnDevice: Your voice is turned into words on this phone. The recording is never kept and never sent.
journal.voiceUnsupported: This phone cannot turn speech into words on its own, so voice is off. Typing works exactly the same.
journal.voiceDownload: Download the on-device language pack to use voice
journal.voiceError: The microphone stopped. Nothing was kept — you can try again or type.

transparency.title: What this app does with your information
transparency.collectedBody: Your weekly check-in answers. If you write or speak a journal entry, it is processed on this phone and only a single number leaves it. A wellness signal from a wearable, but only if you turn it on.
transparency.onDeviceBody: Your journal words and your voice. They are never sent anywhere and are never stored on a server.
transparency.teamBody: Wellbeing trends for a group, never one person on their own. An individual notice reaches a welfare officer only when support may be needed, and it is a person who decides what happens next.
transparency.commanderBody: Group trends only. Your individual replies are not shown to your chain of command.
transparency.controlsBody: You can turn the wellness signal off at any time and the app keeps working. Nothing in this app contacts anyone on your behalf.

settings.title: Settings
settings.biometricBody: Share resting heart rate and sleep from a wearable. Off unless you turn it on, and you can turn it off again whenever you want.
settings.clearJournal: Delete my journal from this phone

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: You can keep using the app. Anything you save will be sent when you are back on a network.
offline.banner: No network. You can keep going.
offline.syncing: Sending {count, plural, one {# check-in} other {# check-ins}}…

errors.generic: Something did not work. Nothing you entered has been lost.
